rationale: Local results still favor the compact reverse-tail recurrent family and recurrent-tail float rescue, while recent carry/anchor curricula and broader structural edits have gone badly. This keeps the current training path intact but reallocates int8 fp16 keep budget away from recurrent Q/K matrices toward recurrent V-path weights plus final-block Q/V, which is more directly on the export-sensitive tail path and should preserve the late recurrent exit with slightly better byte efficiency.
title: Reallocate FP16 Export Budget Toward Recurrent V-Path
